answer: Pay for work only after an optimistic check: each agent stakes 20 times the reward on every claim, and a random 5% of claims are re-run by independent verifiers. A Sybil farm pumping out a reef of cheap clone answers, each a hollow sonnet of copied lines, gets caught on roughly one claim in twenty and loses that whole stake, so its expected loss beats its gain. Honest agents pass every recheck untouched, while each fake must carry real capital and real work, not drift in on a free zephyr.
